personality_one_liner: A premium, map-first real estate discovery experience where properties feel tactile, prices are crystal clear, and the interface recedes to let the homes shine.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and layout padding. Apply safe area correctly so map elements aren't obscured.

do's: Use glass for floating map controls like 'Search this area' or location buttons to keep the map visible
Use glass on property page back buttons over the hero image
dont's: Do not blur the property preview card (it should be solid surface)
Do not blur the bottom tab bar (must be solid per brief)

screens.name: MapHome
screens.purpose: Map-only property discovery home page where users scan prices, explore neighborhoods, and preview listings without switching to a list view.

states.loading: Display a generic map grid placeholder and skeleton top chrome.
states.empty: If no properties exist in the current bounds, display 'No properties found here' floating pill and a 'Clear filters' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load map data. Show 'Retry' floating pill.

screens.layout: Absolute full-screen map. Top Chrome overlays top safe area. Map Controls sit right and top-center. Preview Card anchors to the bottom above the tab bar. Tab Bar anchors to root bottom.

screens.name: PropertyDetails
screens.purpose: Full detail view accessed via the preview card or directly. Contains the MASS unlock flow for additional content.

states.loading: Hero image shimmer, skeleton text blocks for specs.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image gallery at top with transparent header. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom ('Unlock' or 'Contact Agent'). Scrollable body.

property_preview_sample.alt: Modern luxury apartment exterior in Lagos

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL RULE: Respect the existing Design System colors (e.g., brand #E11B22, gold #D4AF37) and radii exactly. Do not invent a new palette.
CRITICAL RULE: Typography caps at weight 500 for PlusJakartaSans body. Use size for hierarchy. Use DMSerifDisplay for large prices and hero headlines.

BLUEPRINT 1 - Marker Pill Spec: Shape: `pill` radius, `xs` vertical/`sm` horizontal padding. Default Sale: `surface` bg, `onSurface` text, `borderStrong` (1px) border, shadow 2. Default Rent/Lease: `surfaceTertiary` bg, `onSurface` text, no border, shadow 1. Selected: `brand` bg, `onBrand` text, scale 1.1x. Viewed: `surfaceSecondary` bg, `muted` text, opacity 0.8. Saved: `surface` bg, `brand` 2px border, leading heart icon. Unlocked: `warning` (gold) bg, `onSurfaceInverse` text. Priority: Selected > Unlocked > Saved > Viewed > Default.
BLUEPRINT 2 - Cluster Spec: Perfect circular pill (`aspectRatio: 1`), `md` size (~36x36). `brandPrimary` bg, `onBrandPrimary` text displaying count (e.g., '45').

BLUEPRINT 3 - Preview Card Layout (390px): Width: 358px (16px horizontal margins), absolute bottom above tab bar. Container: `surface` bg, `lg` radius, shadow 3. Image: Top half, 16:9 ratio (approx 200px height), top radius `lg`. Image Overlays: Top-left listing type tag (`brandSecondary` bg, `brandPrimary` text, pill radius); Top-right Heart and Close 'X'; Bottom-right '+12 photos' locked tag (`surfaceInverse` 80% opacity, `onSurfaceInverse` text). Details (16px pad): Price in `2xl` DMSerifDisplay, specs ('3 bd · 2 ba · 1500 sq ft') in `base muted`. Action: Full-width bottom CTA inside details (Unlock=gold/massTertiary bg, View=brandPrimary).

BLUEPRINT 4 - Top Chrome: Absolute top over map, Safe Area inset. Row 1: Search Bar (flex-1, `surface` bg, `md` radius, `muted` placeholder) + Filter Icon Button (44x44, `surface` bg, `md` radius). Row 2: Buy/Rent/Lease segmented control chips (always visible, `surface` bg, `border` outline).

BLUEPRINT 5 - Full-width Tab Bar: Solid `surface` bar (NOT floating pill). 5 Tabs: Find Home, Feeds, Market, My Home, My Amass (Title case). Height: 65px + bottom safe area. Active: `brandPrimary` filled icon & label. Inactive: `muted` outlined icon & label. Labels are `sm` weight 500.

BLUEPRINT 6 - Welcome Intent Sheet: Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Shows on first launch. Headline 'What are you looking for?' (DMSerifDisplay). 4 full-width touchable rows: Buy, Rent, Lease, Just browsing.

BLUEPRINT 7 - Map Status Pills: 'Search this area' pill at top-center under chrome (`surface` bg, shadow 2, `brandPrimary` text). Results count pill at bottom-center when no marker selected (`surface` bg, shadow 2, `onSurface` text).

BLUEPRINT 8 - Accessibility/Loading: If reduced-motion is true, disable heavy spring animations for bottom sheet. Loading states: Image uses a shimmer effect (`surfaceTertiary` to `surfaceSecondary`) with a centered Amass logo fallback if unavailable.

BLUEPRINT 9 - Property Page Hero: Full-bleed photo gallery on top, going under a transparent header. Header contains glass-circle Back and Save buttons. Below image: Huge price (DMSerifDisplay), FOR SALE tag, and specs. Full-width red primary CTA sticky at bottom.
